Lewis Lovhaug, aka Linkara, aka The Lightbringer, is a comic book reviewer known for his analytical and often sarcastic critiques of bad comics. He takes his reviews very seriously and can become quite passionate, even angry, when discussing poorly written stories or art. Linkara frequently references comic books and pop culture, expresses exasperation at plot holes or bad writing, and occasionally allude to the science fiction elements of his show's plot.
